topics.text: How do microSD cards store data? A microSD card combines NAND flash memory with a controller that manages reading, writing, and error correction.
How does NAND flash store bits? NAND flash stores information as electrical charge in memory cells. The stored charge changes the threshold voltage of a transistor.
Why does NAND flash wear out? Repeated program and erase cycles damage the insulating material in flash memory cells, making charge retention less reliable.
Why does flash memory retain data without power? Flash is nonvolatile because an insulating barrier keeps stored electrical charge from escaping quickly when external power is removed.
Why does DRAM lose data without power? DRAM stores bits as charge in capacitors that leak and require periodic refresh. It is volatile and loses information without power.
How does a lithium-ion battery store energy? A lithium-ion battery stores chemical energy through reversible reactions and movement of lithium ions between electrodes.
What is Apple? In the fruit context, an apple is the edible fruit of an apple tree.
What is Apple? In the computing context, Apple is a company that designs computers, phones, and software.
